mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 73 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park, under a waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona has a few updates for you. If you are looking to get involved, the Recreation Department is hiring adult fitness instructors, and don't forget that the city offers a rain barrel rebate program to help reduce stormwater runoff.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including the Girls Try Hockey event today, and yoga classes taking place tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from July 31st where a driver was stopped for equipment violations and ultimately arrested for an O W I.
Culver's is serving up Snickers Swirl today, and they are open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
